data.gender_notes: Shayansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lord Shiva, the Hindu god of wisdom, strength, and destruction, is the origin of the name Shayansh. It is a unique and powerful name suitable for a child with a strong spirit and intelligent mind. The name Shayansh carries the meaning “God of wisdom and strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shayansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shayansh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
